description: Each day is planned on its own each morning. When the athlete's day is different, this tells the coach how many minutes they have today and what they cannot do, and the coach plans today's sessions again around it. Returns them. Takes up to a minute.

cannot_do.description: What they cannot do today, e.g. swimming when there is no pool. Omit if everything is possible.

minutes.description: Minutes they have for training today.

today.description: The person's local date as YYYY-MM-DD, the day before if it is earlier than 05:00 where they are. Omit if unknown.

name: morning_check_in
title: Change today
